'''Hartha''' is the leader of the [[Seanchan]] [[Ogier]] who came to the [[Westlands]] during the ''[[Corenne]]''. He is second in command to Empress [[Tuon Paendrag]]'s bodyguard, and is a loyal friend to [[Furyk Karede]].

== Appearance ==
He is weathered and grizzled, with long gray mustaches and eyes like black stones. He is almost as tall as a man in a saddle and very wide.

== Activities ==
He joins up with Karede and Captain [[Musenge]] on the hunt to track down Tuon.

He enters [[Gamel Loune]]'s camp with Karede, looking for information on the army causing havoc on the Seanchan forces, which may have Tuon captive. 
When the camp where Tuon is held is found, he goes with Karede to meet with the leader of it. Karede takes Tuon back to [[Ebou Dar]] leaving Hartha with [[Matrim Cauthon]]. Mat's [[Band of the Red Hand]] engages a rogue Seanchan force looking to kill Tuon for a reward. The Band wipe the Seanchan force out, and Hartha retrieves [[Zaired Elbar]]'s head, where it is taken Back to Ebou Dar.
